segments.en: That's not the only deal news being delivered up today. DoorDash has agreed to buy rival Instacart for about $17 billion.
segments.zh: 今天不止这一条交易消息。DoorDash已同意以约170亿美元收购竞争对手Instacart。

segments.en: Here's what DoorDash CEO, Tony Chu, had to say about the tie-up during a call earlier.
segments.zh: DoorDash首席执行官Tony Chu在早些时候的电话会议上谈到了这笔交易。

segments.en: When I think about this, you know, this really is about giving every retailer every size the ability to compete in a world where technology is only accelerating faster, disruption is
segments.zh: 我认为，这实际上是为了让各种规模的零售商都能在技术加速发展、颠覆更快发生的世界中竞争。

segments.en: happening more quickly, and the world's biggest companies are becoming larger.
segments.zh: 而且全球最大的公司正在变得更大。

segments.en: All right, let's bring in Bloomberg's Natalie Lung for the details. What are the details? How is DoorDash going to get this done?
segments.zh: 好的，我们请彭博社的Natalie Lung来介绍细节。具体细节是什么？DoorDash将如何完成这笔交易？

segments.en: Yeah, so this deal is still going to, you know, pending and he trust regulator approval and Instacart Shareholder approval, and it's going to, you know, take a while for it to close
segments.zh: 这笔交易仍需监管机构和Instacart股东批准，完成还需要一段时间，可能要到明年年底甚至2028年。

segments.en: towards the end of next year or even in 2028. But, you know, DoorDash is already promising a lot of things to keep customers excited. You know, paid the paid membership for DashPass and Instacart Plus.
segments.zh: 但DoorDash已经承诺了很多来保持客户兴奋。比如DashPass和Instacart Plus的付费会员。

segments.en: It's expected to combine together in the future. You know, people just have to pay one of them.
segments.zh: 预计未来会合并，人们只需支付其中一个。

segments.en: And obviously, this will offer more selection to both Instacart and DoorDash customers.
segments.zh: 显然，这将为Instacart和DoorDash的客户提供更多选择。

segments.en: But the bigger thing here is really, as the CEO said in the call, this will better set up DoorDash to compete against giants like Walmart and Amazon, which have very strong
segments.zh: 但更重要的是，正如CEO在电话会议上所说，这将使DoorDash更好地与沃尔玛和亚马逊等巨头竞争，这些巨头非常强大。

segments.en: direct shopping websites and don't need to rely on third-party apps like Instacart and Uber or DoorDash.
segments.zh: 直接购物网站，无需依赖Instacart、Uber或DoorDash等第三方应用。
